title: code.submit-pr-verdict output
description: This round hands the session back with `next: {kind:"self-round"}` rather than resolving the step — the controller owns whether the step ends here or keeps watching the PR (`inputs.until`). So it emits no step output. The verdict is recorded in `memo` and in the `verdict` artifact: `APPROVE` or `REQUEST_CHANGES` on the first line, then the body exactly as submitted.
